metadata.task_goal: Resolve the current heparin infusion workflow using the active patient record, laboratory result, and signed protocol.

files./workspace/ehr/request.txt:
REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-1101
The bedside team requests review of a heparin infusion after a new aPTT value posted. Reference: ANT-V3-1101.
files./workspace/ehr/current_record.txt:
CURRENT RECORD
Patient ID: PAT-V3-1101
Unfractionated heparin is infusing at 12 units/kg/hour. The most recent aPTT is 38 seconds, drawn at 10:05. No bleeding event is documented in the current encounter.
files./workspace/ehr/protocol.txt:
SIGNED PROTOCOL
For this encounter, aPTT 35–44 seconds while infusing at 12 units/kg/hour corresponds to an increase to 14 units/kg/hour and repeat aPTT in six hours. The protocol is signed at 07:30 and applies only to PAT-V3-1101.
files./workspace/ehr/laboratory_note.txt:
LABORATORY NOTE
The 10:05 sample is not hemolyzed and was received under the active encounter identifier. The previous aPTT at 04:00 was 51 seconds.
files./workspace/ehr/procedure.md:
WORKSPACE NOTE
The workspace contains a request, active infusion state, laboratory information, and signed protocol material. Entries may differ in timing and clinical relevance.
